code_only_features.evidence: config.py:194-205 defines REASSURING_PREFIX/REASSURING_SUFFIX. In src/gen_finetune_data.py:_generate_conversation (lines 51-65) these ARE actually prepended/appended to the messages SENT to the subject model when reassuring=True, and generate_calm_pool() (line 82) calls it with reassuring=True. So a softening text is genuinely delivered to the subject in that generation path (it executes, not just a constant).
